summary: Reduce redundant Mac LFL Web SSE fingerprint scans, same-session message reloads and hidden-tab approval/coordination polling without changing Host approval authority or Run recovery.

components.owning_subsystem: Web SSE events and existing session-directory fingerprint scan
components.disposition: Reuse the existing SSE fingerprint contract; cache successful scans in-process for at most 1 second, cap entries at 32, isolate roots by absolute path and never cache errors.
evidence: 8-thread single-flight, cross-root isolation, expiry and failure tests in tests/web/test_sse_fingerprint_cache.py
Independent full_test reviewer subagent_171c0122bfc8 PASS P0=0 P1=0 P2=2 for original 9-file SHA 1463062a3; manifest addition requires new exact-SHA review.
components.verification_level: Focused Python 53/53 and original full R9 exit 0; new SHA must pass A.5, independent review, full R9, PR CI before merge.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reject if an error result is cached, a workspace shares another root's fingerprint, a changed session becomes invisible, or the global lock causes unacceptable production latency.
components.rollback_route: Revert the Web CPU change and its declaration; previous direct scan path remains available.

components.owning_subsystem: WebUI SSE event handling and existing session/message stores
components.disposition: Reuse existing sessions_updated, visibility and watchdog events; coalesce concurrent refreshes, reload current messages when observable metadata changes, and preserve messages on fetch failure.
evidence: webui/src/events-sync.test.ts covers event coalescing, visibility catch-up and failure retention
Reviewer identified nonblocking P2: rare edits or metadata/event ordering could delay reload until another event; do not claim a server invariant not demonstrated.
components.verification_level: WebUI 612/612 tests, TypeScript typecheck and production build passed for original candidate; new SHA CI still required.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto on missed ordinary new messages, stale approval state, dropped messages after fetch error or permanently wedged sync; validate server metadata update order in production.
components.rollback_route: Revert this event-sync change while retaining original SSE and watchdog behavior.

components.owning_subsystem: WebUI read-only coordination panels and Escalation Center; Host remains sole approval authority
components.disposition: Skip timer reads while the tab is hidden, immediately catch up on visibility restoration, remove timers/listeners on unmount, and share in-flight approval GET requests; never auto-approve.
evidence: webui/src/components/sidebar/poll-visibility.test.tsx checks hidden pause and visible catch-up
webui/src/components/sidebar/EscalationCenter.test.tsx checks in-flight request sharing; existing Host approval path remains unchanged.
components.verification_level: Full WebUI 612/612 tests and production build passed on original candidate; real browser and approval negative checks remain deployment gates.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reject if hiding a tab drops a real approval, if restoring visibility fails to refresh, if a GET request triggers approval, or if cleanup leaves orphan timers.
components.rollback_route: Revert the three sidebar component edits; do not change Host approval grants or ledger.

components.disposition: Add deterministic regression and negative tests for dedup, concurrency, visibility, errors and cleanup.
evidence: Python Web 53/53, WebUI 612/612 on original candidate; full original R9 15,726 passed, 162 skipped, 3 xfailed.
components.verification_level: Automated tests executed on original candidate; new SHA requires fresh full R9 and remote CI.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Fail if tests do not assert real network request counts, visibility behavior or failure retention.
components.rollback_route: Revert tests with their corresponding implementation.

components.disposition: Declare the exact 10 changed paths and control ownership without changing gate rules.
evidence: PR #70 A.5 remote CI failed on 1463062a3: expected exactly one changed architecture-submission manifest, found 0.
components.verification_level: Local structural and coverage validation before commit; remote A.5 required on new exact SHA.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: HOLD if declaration paths do not exactly match changed files, if A.5 fails, or if claimed review evidence belongs to a different SHA.
components.rollback_route: Revert this declaration together with the patch.

g1.necessity: Repeated per-client SSE directory fingerprint scans caused avoidable filesystem work and CPU even when no session changed.

g2.authority_owner: Existing Web SSE session-directory scanner and event emitter; this patch introduces no new security authority.
g2.non_duplication: Keep one existing fingerprint source and event format; add bounded short-lived memoization, not a second scanner or scheduler.

model_evidence: Original independent reviewer PASS P0=0 P1=0 P2=2; new manifest SHA still needs review.
Backend regression tests include concurrency, expiry, cross-root isolation and error non-caching.
g3.recovery_or_reason: On cache miss or expiry rescan; on error do not cache. If latency regresses across workspaces, revert without data migration.

g4.rollback: Revert cache patch and declaration; no persistence migration.
verification: A.5 exact path coverage, Python regressions, full R9, remote CI and production CPU/request comparison.
Confirm no changes to SSE payload semantics or security policy.

g1.necessity: Repeated sessions_updated events reloaded the same 100 messages even without observable changes, amplifying CPU and network load.

g2.authority_owner: Existing WebUI SSE listener and sessionStore/messageStore; server remains source of session truth.
g2.non_duplication: No new polling loop or second session cache; coalesce the existing sync path and compare existing metadata.

model_evidence: Original WebUI 612 tests passed; dedicated events-sync tests exercise coalescing and failure retention.
Reviewer P2: server metadata/event ordering invariant is not proven for rare in-place edits.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Visibility/watchdog paths still resync; preserve existing messages on transient failure; escalate missed-message reports and revert if required.

g4.rollback: Revert events.ts and tests, restore unconditional refresh behavior.
verification: Run full WebUI tests, typecheck, build, full R9 and PR CI on new SHA.
Production verify new messages, edits, background Run continuation and tab visibility catch-up.

g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing timers, visibilitychange and in-flight fetch promises; no second approval queue, scheduler or signing path.

model_evidence: Hidden-tab tests verify zero hidden fetches and immediate visible catch-up.
Escalation tests verify same in-flight fetch shared; no approval POST or authority changes.

Post-deploy verify pending approvals, Lane Board and coordination refresh when tab becomes visible.
